known_GBC_sentence_correction.original:
For non-set-like relations, the model's class collection can matter to
the well-order assertion.
known_GBC_sentence_correction.replacement:
Over $\GBC$, well-foundedness of any fixed class relation is equivalent
to the absence of a set-coded descending $\omega$-sequence. Keeping the
sets and the relation fixed while enlarging the class collection therefore
does not change its internal well-foundedness. What may change is which
class relations are available; internal and external well-foundedness
must also be distinguished.
